kultivator.disciples.scroll.tooltip: Use: accept a new disciple at your side (a Mortal whose spiritual root is tested at once).
kultivator.disciples.scroll.tooltip_limi: A master guides at least %s disciples at once; a higher Sect Hall level allows more.
kultivator.disciples.tablet.tooltip: Use: call the soul back into a body (only its master can).
kultivator.disciples.tablet.tooltip_safe: Fire, lava, explosions and cactus cannot harm it.
kultivator.disciples.tablet.empty: This tablet is empty: no soul rests in it.
kultivator.disciples.welcome: %s kneels and bows three times: "Guru, please accept this disciple! I will walk the Dao at your side."
kultivator.disciples.welcome.hint: Right-click your disciple to open its scroll: teach techniques, give pills and give orders.
kultivator.disciples.full: You already guide %s/%s disciples. Release one before accepting another.
kultivator.disciples.no_space: There is no safe ground next to you for your disciple to stand on.
kultivator.disciples.died: Your disciple %s has fallen! Its soul now rests in a Soul Tablet at %s, %s, %s (%s).
kultivator.disciples.died.carried: Your disciple %s has fallen into the void! Its Soul Tablet flew back to you.
kultivator.disciples.died.hint: Pick up the glowing tablet and use it to call the soul back.
kultivator.disciples.revive: %s opens their eyes again: "Guru! This disciple has returned from the edge of death."
kultivator.disciples.revive.not_owner: The soul in this tablet answers only to its master, %s.
kultivator.disciples.revive.stale: This tablet is only an echo: the soul it held already walks the world again.
kultivator.disciples.order.none: No disciple of yours is within %s blocks. Look at one, or use /kultivasi murid panggil to call them all.
kultivator.disciples.too_far: %s is too far away (at most %s blocks).
kultivator.disciples.gone: That disciple is no longer here.
kultivator.disciples.release.farewell: %s bows deeply: "Thank you for your guidance, Guru. May we meet again on the Dao."
kultivator.disciples.release.done: %s has left to walk their own path.
kultivator.disciples.list.empty: You have no disciples yet. Place a Sect Hall Stele: candidates arrive at dawn every few days.
kultivator.disciples.list.forget_hint: Is a living disciple lost for good (its body vanished)? /kultivasi murid lupakan <number> frees its place.
kultivator.disciples.forget.bad_index: There is no disciple number %s in your list (see /kultivasi murid list).
kultivator.disciples.forget.fallen: %s has already fallen: its Soul Tablet can call it back, and a fallen soul does not take up a place.
kultivator.disciples.forget.loaded: %s is in the world right now. Release it from its scroll instead (Pills & Breakthrough tab).
kultivator.disciples.forget.warn: %s will be forgotten for good: if its body still lives in a place that is not loaded, it will leave as soon as that place loads again, and no tablet can call it back. Type /kultivasi murid lupakan %s konfirmasi to confirm.
kultivator.disciples.forget.done: %s is no longer counted among your disciples. Its place is free.
kultivator.disciples.call.done: %s disciples answer your call and gather around you.
kultivator.disciples.call.none: No disciple of yours can hear you (only disciples in loaded places answer).
kultivator.disciples.debug.no_target: Look at a disciple within 16 blocks.
advancement.kultivator.five_disciples.de: Guide five disciples at the same time
Call a fallen disciple back to life with their Soul Tablet
